acceptance_commands: uv sync --frozen && uv run pytest -q tests/test_r3_stop_response.py
env -u ALL_PROXY -u all_proxy -u HTTP_PROXY -u http_proxy -u HTTPS_PROXY -u https_proxy make verify

env -u ALL_PROXY -u all_proxy -u HTTP_PROXY -u http_proxy -u HTTPS_PROXY -u https_proxy bash -c 'R=/tmp/r3-accept-testenv; rm -rf "$R"; bash scripts/testenv.sh up --root "$R" >/tmp/r3-te-up.out 2>&1; uprc=$?; V="env -u ALL_PROXY -u all_proxy -u HTTP_PROXY -u http_proxy -u HTTPS_PROXY -u https_proxy"; CHK(){ bash -c "$V bash scripts/verify-rebuild.sh --env test --root $R --check $1" | grep -cE "^$1 [a-z0-9-]+ PASS — "; }; c11=$( [ "$uprc" -eq 0 ] && CHK 11 ); c12=$( [ "$uprc" -eq 0 ] && CHK 12 ); c17=$( [ "$uprc" -eq 0 ] && CHK 17 ); c18=$( [ "$uprc" -eq 0 ] && CHK 18 ); c19=$( [ "$uprc" -eq 0 ] && CHK 19 ); lines=$( [ "$uprc" -eq 0 ] && bash -c "$V bash scripts/verify-rebuild.sh --env test --root $R" | grep -cE "^[0-9]{2} [a-z0-9-]+ (PASS|FAIL) — " ); bash scripts/testenv.sh down --root "$R" >/tmp/r3-te-down.out 2>&1; drc=$?; refs=$(grep -oE "prod_references=[0-9]+" /tmp/r3-te-down.out | head -1); echo "up=$uprc lines=$lines c11=$c11 c12=$c12 c17=$c17 c18=$c18 c19=$c19 down=$drc $refs"; test "$uprc" -eq 0 -a "$lines" -eq 21 -a "$c11" -eq 1 -a "$c12" -eq 1 -a "$c17" -eq 1 -a "$c18" -eq 1 -a "$c19" -eq 1 -a "$drc" -eq 0 -a "$refs" = "prod_references=0"'
